title: Storage accounts: kinds, replication and the naming that survives

videos.script: This course follows the data of one company. Quitanda delivers groceries in São Paulo, and every night its shop exports the day's orders. {{export}} Those files have to land somewhere. They have to stay for years, be read by the right people and by nobody else, and cost as little as they can. On Azure that is Blob Storage, and it is the first seven lessons. {{blob}} You will practise it on your own computer. There is no Azure account in this course. The real Azure command line talks to Azurite, Microsoft's own emulator, running in a container on your laptop. {{azurite}} An emulator answers like Azure and checks much less. This lesson shows you where it stops, so that a success never fools you. {{limits}} Then the storage account. It is where three choices are made for everything inside it: the kind, the performance and how many copies Azure keeps. {{account}} And you will choose names that still make sense in five years, because nothing in Blob Storage can be renamed. {{names}}
